changes.why: v0.6.0 renamed propOrDefault to propOr; R.propOrDefault is gone
new name in v0.6.0 for propOrDefault, same code: hasOwnProperty.call(obj, p) ? obj[p] : val
new in v0.6.0: R.cond(condition, onTrue, onFalse) returns a function that applies onTrue or onFalse to its arguments according to condition
new in v0.6.0: R.trim(str) removes the leading and trailing runs of its 26 whitespace characters (U+180E included, the fallback node runs)
